name: Kerosine (petroleum), hydrodesulfurized thermal cracked; Cracked kerosine; [A complex combination of hydrocarbons obtained by fractionation from hydrodesulfurized thermal cracker distillate. It consists predominantly of hydrocarbons predominantly in the range of C8 to C16 and boiling in the range of approximately 120 °C to 283 °C (284 °F to 541 °F).]
